free_tier.stated: Ultimate (paid, EUR 3.33-14.99/mo): 'Unlimited Storage' and 'Unlimited File Size'. Free registered accounts are explicitly limited: 'Free accounts have a limited storage allowance' — the number is not published on the pricing page.

retention.stated: Free: unpublished storage allowance, 60-day deletion after no access

egress.terms: Ultimate 200 GB/day download traffic (195 GB/account/day ); free is speed-limited, gated by a human-verification step, single-stream, with daily limits. No per-GB price.

chaining: Only the paid tier reaches unlimited, so this is a EUR 40/year route to unlimited storage rather than a free one. Email-only signup.

limits.value: bandwidth, unlimited storage or unlimited downloads')

limits_note: Free: unpublished storage allowance, 60-day deletion after no access. Ultimate: unlimited storage, 120-day retention, 195-200 GB/day download. Guest accounts (app, no email) delete after 7 days. Copy/import throttles: 1,000 files/hour, torrent 4 jobs/hour, 25 GB/job.
